title: The Stick
source: FETCH / Forty Years of Good Dogs
slide_prompts: A fishing vessel at anchor near a volcanic island in Southeast Alaska at deep twilight, navigation lights painting red and green across black water, a waxing moon reflected in the still harbor, watercolor painting style with rich dark tones

An old shaggy dock dog sitting at the end of a weathered wooden pier with a smooth worn stick in its mouth, staring at calm gray water, late afternoon light, the dog is patient and dignified, watercolor style
A smooth river-worn wooden stick lying on weathered dock planks in moonlight, the stick is old and chewed smooth by years of teeth, close-up still life, warm amber and silver tones, watercolor style

An empty pier at dusk in a small Southeast Alaska fishing town, the wood weathered and silver, mountains in fog behind, a single harbor light reflected in still water, no people, sense of patient absence, watercolor painting
A whiskey glass on a wooden bar top, half-empty, ice melting, warm amber light from an unseen lamp, blurred background of a dark ship's interior, intimate moody still life, oil painting style
